figurative_meaning_en: Firm and steadfast conviction or belief
example_sentences_in_bangla: আমার একিন হচ্ছে না যে তুমি এই কথা বলেছো।
তার একিন যে সে সফল হবে, কেউ টলাতে পারবে না।
example_sentences_in_english: I can't shake my conviction that you said this.
His belief that he will succeed is unshakable.
note: This idiom reflects a sense of inner certainty often used in everyday Bengali discourse to express unyielding personal assurance.
